params.geometry_source: Orbformer BBMEP set, Ethane C-H/N-H homolysis path image 11 (AutoNEB, 20 images), github.com/microsoft/oneqmc @ 46ddc5a data/bbmep/Ethane/11.yaml (ångström, converted)

rows.method_detail: one multi-geometry model trained jointly on the 20 images of the path, (h1, h2) = (128, 32), 16 determinants, no HF pretraining
rows.method_as_published: NucleoNet [VMC, one multi-geometry model trained jointly on the 20 images of the path, (h1, h2) = (128, 32), 16 determinants, no HF pretraining]
rows.bound_type_reason: the energy of a stated wave function (Hartree-Fock, DMRG at a stated bond dimension, MRCI, VMC, a neural-network state); an upper bound in the instance's basis (RULES.md 13.4; assigned during source reading)
rows.reference: Q. Gao, Y. Huang, E. Hou, Y. Liu, J. Chen and H. Wang, NucleoNet: A Nuclear-Aware Determinant Ansatz for Multi-Geometry Neural Variational Monte Carlo, arXiv:2610.12985 (2026)

verified.method: source text of arXiv:2610.12985 read locally (pypdf layout text; the generator finds every value again on its line), no LLM transcription of numbers; single reading
verified.note: arXiv:2610.12985 SI Table S7 (Ethane column), text line 997 | Hartree, total energy, all-electron. Path image 11; N_up = N_dn (spin 0 in the data file): along the homolysis the computed sector is the singlet one, the lowest state of which may be an open-shell singlet.
